purpose: Computational augmentation to reduce redundant provider work while preserving evidence and uncertainty

use_now: Explicit dependency gate within the existing semantic review
Compact transport retaining complete claims, parent context, evidence and occurrence offsets
Complete-cost grammar and conservative progression-scope abstention
defer: Learned deck-fit ranker or distillation: insufficient independent adjudicated labels
Scalar/Pareto pruning across mana, energy, sacrifice, output and timing: incomparable resources and unknown prerequisites
Smaller-model or confidence bypass of strategy review without a quality evaluation
ANN or more encoder/model concurrency on the shared 8GB host
retain: Full candidate coverage and eligibility checks
One corrective followup when an explicit missing rule has new complete candidate evidence
Full corrective evidence/context where complete dependency closure is unproved

contracts: Retrieval gaps are typed proposals, never evidence or verdicts. Unspecified, current-state, strategic and reviewer uncertainty do not trigger generic rule searches.
Missing rule propositions receive query space before long claims. New official text is candidate evidence, never certified entailment.
Claim IDs, source indices, exact local spans/hashes, protected units, citation membership and correction binding remain authoritative.
Only opaque claim/parent hashes leave the model wire; occurrence offsets, exact text, full evidence and parent context remain. JSON is minified.
Skipped corrective work preserves all original judgments, supported fragments, unresolved claims and whole-request fulfillment.
Unsupported progression/cost forms remain unknown rather than receiving fabricated zero or unconditional graph support. Oracle text is retained.
New source identity/hash/index diagnostics are append-only. No cross-request semantic verdict cache or training was added.
